parameters.content:
## ✅ Setup Notes

**This workflow hands the upload off to the dashboard** so you get live byte-level progress in the UI.

**1. Connect YouTube** (one time)
→ Open `http://localhost:8080/oauth/youtube/start` and authorize.

**2. (Optional) AI: Enrich Metadata** → set OpenRouter Header Auth credential.

**3. Activate** the workflow (top-right toggle).

---
🔗 Webhook path: `POST /webhook/idm-yt-download`
📦 Hands off to: `http://dashboard:8080/api/upload/youtube`
📊 Live progress at: `http://localhost:8080/queue`
⚠️ Delete other workflows using the same webhook path first.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.ai_model, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.ai_system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.ai_user }], temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 800 }) }}

nodes.name: AI: Enrich Metadata
nodes.notes: Uses ai_model / ai_system / ai_user from the payload, set per-destination in the dashboard. continueOnFail=true so upload still works without AI.

nodes.name: Hand off → Dashboard upload
nodes.notes: Dashboard does the resumable upload in the background and reports progress via SSE.
